# Miraculous Cleaning Services LLC

> Winter Haven, Florida commercial cleaning company providing office and janitorial cleaning, floor care, pressure washing, window cleaning, post-construction cleanup and deep cleaning for businesses and commercial facilities.

- Business name: Miraculous Cleaning Services LLC (also known as Miraculous or Miraculous Commercial Cleaning)
- Location: Winter Haven, Florida, United States
- Phone: (863) 221-6645
- Availability: 24/7, including nights and weekends
- Consultations: free on-site consultation and written quote
- Payment: debit and credit cards accepted
- Service area: Winter Haven, Lakeland, Bartow, Auburndale, Lake Alfred, Eagle Lake, Haines City, Lake Wales, Davenport, Polk County
- Serves: offices, medical and professional suites, retail storefronts, warehouses and light industrial facilities, new construction and renovations, property managers

## Services

- [Office & Janitorial Cleaning](https://mtexidor7.github.io/miraculous-cleaning/services/office-janitorial-cleaning/): Office janitorial cleaning is the recurring care that keeps a workplace sanitary and presentable: desks and high-touch surfaces wiped, restrooms and break rooms cleaned, trash removed and floors vacuumed or mopped on a set schedule.
- [Commercial Floor Care](https://mtexidor7.github.io/miraculous-cleaning/services/commercial-floor-care/): Commercial floor care restores and protects hard floors. Old finish is stripped away, the floor is deep cleaned, fresh coats of finish are applied, and regular burnishing keeps a high gloss that resists scuffs and foot traffic.
- [Commercial Pressure Washing](https://mtexidor7.github.io/miraculous-cleaning/services/pressure-washing/): Commercial pressure washing uses high pressure water and surface cleaning equipment to remove dirt, gum, oil stains, mildew and algae from sidewalks, entryways, storefronts and building exteriors.
- [Commercial Window Cleaning](https://mtexidor7.github.io/miraculous-cleaning/services/window-cleaning/): Commercial window cleaning removes dirt, water spots, pollen and fingerprints from storefront glass, office windows, glass doors and interior partitions, leaving clear, streak-free glass.
- [Post-Construction Cleanup](https://mtexidor7.github.io/miraculous-cleaning/services/post-construction-cleaning/): Post-construction cleaning removes the dust, debris, stickers, paint specks and residue left after building or renovation work, so a new commercial space is safe, presentable and ready for occupancy.
- [Commercial Deep Cleaning](https://mtexidor7.github.io/miraculous-cleaning/services/commercial-deep-cleaning/): Commercial deep cleaning is a detailed top-to-bottom clean that reaches what routine service skips: buildup in restrooms and kitchens, high and low dusting, vents, baseboards and disinfection of high-touch surfaces.

## Frequently asked questions

### What commercial cleaning services does Miraculous offer in Winter Haven?
Miraculous Cleaning Services LLC provides office and janitorial cleaning, commercial floor care (stripping, waxing and burnishing), pressure washing, window cleaning, post-construction cleanup and commercial deep cleaning for businesses in Winter Haven, Florida and nearby Polk County communities.

### Is Miraculous available nights and weekends?
Yes. Miraculous offers 24/7 availability, so cleaning can be scheduled after hours, overnight, early morning or on weekends to avoid interrupting your business.

### How much does commercial cleaning cost in Winter Haven, FL?
Pricing depends on square footage, how often you need service, the type of facility and the tasks in your scope. Miraculous offers a free consultation and walkthrough, then provides a written quote based on your building's needs.

### How do I get a commercial cleaning quote?
Call (863) 221-6645 or send the quote request form on this page with your property type, approximate square footage and preferred frequency. Miraculous will follow up to schedule a free consultation.

### What types of businesses do you clean?
Miraculous cleans offices, medical and professional suites, retail storefronts, warehouses and light industrial spaces, newly constructed or renovated spaces, and properties managed by property management companies.

### Which areas do you serve?
Miraculous is based in Winter Haven, Florida and serves businesses in and around Winter Haven, including nearby Polk County communities such as Lakeland, Bartow, Auburndale, Lake Alfred and Haines City. Call to confirm service at your location.

### What payment methods do you accept?
Miraculous accepts debit and credit cards.
